_meta.description: 心理运镜系统：摄影机的每一次运动都与角色内心状态或剧情推演直接绑定
_meta.usage: Director 讲戏时严禁写'镜头推近'这种缺乏情绪的词，必须写明心理动机

psychology_movements.name: 侵入与施压
psychology_movements.psychologicalHint: 揭示真相、内心恐惧放大、反派/强权的致命逼近
psychology_movements.visualFeature: 镜头以不可阻挡的匀速（甚至略带加速）向人物面部推进，空间被急剧压缩
seedancePrompts: aggressive push in, dolly towards character face, rapid zoom, background compression
relentless camera push-in, space compressing around the subject
accelerating dolly in, claustrophobic framing tightening
psychology_movements.taboo: 不要在普通的日常对话中使用，会显得莫名其妙地紧张
psychology_movements.directorExample: [侵入性推进：放大主角得知真相的恐惧]

psychology_movements.name: 疏离与遗弃
psychology_movements.psychologicalHint: 孤独、无助、绝望、或人物被庞大的世界/宿命吞噬
psychology_movements.visualFeature: 镜头缓慢向后退，人物在画面中变得越来越小，周围空旷的负空间越来越多
seedancePrompts: slow pull back, camera dollying out, expanding negative space, character becoming small in the frame
camera retreating, vast emptiness growing around the isolated figure
lonely pull-back reveal, character dwarfed by the environment
psychology_movements.taboo: 不要在角色获得胜利或力量觉醒时使用，这会削弱力量感
psychology_movements.directorExample: [缓慢后退：表现主角被家族遗弃的孤独]

psychology_movements.name: 偷窥与焦虑
psychology_movements.psychologicalHint: 混乱、真实感、极度的心理焦虑、被人暗中监视
psychology_movements.visualFeature: 镜头带有不规则的微小呼吸感或剧烈晃动，甚至焦点不实
seedancePrompts: handheld camera, shaky cam, documentary style, unstable framing
nervous handheld movement, slight out-of-focus moments, voyeuristic angle
breathing camera shake, anxious framing, gritty documentary feel
psychology_movements.taboo: 文戏中如果不是表现极度焦虑，严禁使用晃动镜头，否则会破坏权力的稳定感
psychology_movements.directorExample: [手持晃动：掩盖杀人现场的焦虑]

psychology_movements.name: 迷失与失控
psychology_movements.psychologicalHint: 世界观崩塌、精神失常、走火入魔、邪恶降临

visualFeatures.description: 荷兰角：地平线倾斜，画面不再横平竖直
prompts: Dutch angle, tilted camera, tilted horizon

visualFeatures.description: 滑动变焦：机位后退同时拉长焦，背景剧烈空间扭曲
prompts: vertigo effect, dolly zoom, background warping while subject stays same size

seedancePrompts: Dutch angle, tilted camera, tilted horizon, vertigo effect
dolly zoom, background warping, disorienting perspective distortion
psychology_movements.taboo: 全剧只能在主角三观破碎或大反派现出真身时使用1-2次

psychology_movements.name: 环绕与宿命
psychology_movements.psychologicalHint: 命运的交汇、极致的浪漫、或无路可逃的绝境

visualFeatures.mood: 高光时刻的史诗感或浪漫
visualFeatures.prompt: slow 180-degree arc shot around the character, epic grandeur

visualFeatures.mood: 人物陷入重围、迷失方向或极度恐慌
visualFeatures.prompt: rapid 360-degree spin around the character, disorienting circular tracking

seedancePrompts: camera tracking in a circle around the character, 360 degree arc shot, spinning camera
slow orbit around the subject, revealing the environment from all angles

psychology_movements.name: 穿越与压迫
psychology_movements.psychologicalHint: 强侵入、目标锁定、危险逼近、命悬一线的高速推进感
psychology_movements.visualFeature: 第一人称或高度主观的广角高速前冲，镜头贴着障碍物擦身而过，前景快速切换
triggerConditions: 追逐 / 逃逸 / 坠落 / 闯关 / 穿洞 / 钻缝 / 穿楼 / 通道突破
场景内存在明确的洞口/门窗/裂缝/桥洞/走廊/管道/峡谷
需要观众获得'马上要撞上去'的身体感
seedancePrompts: FPV fly-through, first-person high-speed rush, threading through a narrow gap
near-miss pass, tunnel run, wide-angle distortion, edge motion blur
speeding through corridor, obstacles flashing past, urgent forward momentum

fiveAnchors.entry: 入口建立镜头——明确起点和方向
fiveAnchors.medium: 穿越/撞击/擦身镜头——障碍物、介质、速度参照
fiveAnchors.exit: 出口镜头——穿出后的结果兑现
fiveAnchors.note: 一段 FPV 不得只靠单镜头，默认拆成'入口→穿越→落幅'

psychology_movements.taboo: 不能只写'很快地飞过去'，必须明确入口、穿越介质、出口和结果揭示

levels.name: 轻度 blur
levels.applicable: 一般出拳、闪避、冲刺、轻甩镜
levels.prompt: slight motion blur on the moving limb
levels.usage: 适合大多数商业动作镜头

levels.name: 中度 blur
levels.applicable: 高速连击、横向急闪、武器连续挥砍、快速跟拍
levels.prompt: moderate motion blur on the weapon swing, background streaking

levels.name: 重度 blur
levels.applicable: 极限高速、超能力爆发、极快 whip pan
levels.prompt: heavy motion blur, extreme speed lines, background completely smeared
levels.usage: 只能短时使用，必须配合清晰落点

clear_zones.description: 必须保持清晰的区域——模糊优先用于动作过程，爽点帧必须保持清晰

speed_ramp_protocols.description: 变速节奏协议：Hit Stop / 升格 / 降格

techniques.name: Hit Stop / 命中定格
techniques.description: 命中瞬间画面冻结2-4帧（约0.08-0.17秒），制造极致的冲击感
techniques.prompt: hit stop on impact, brief freeze frame at the moment of contact
techniques.usage: 每个关键命中点必须使用

techniques.name: 升格蓄力
techniques.description: 动作启动前进入慢动作，蓄积力量感
techniques.prompt: slow motion build-up before the strike, speed ramp increasing

techniques.name: 降格释放
techniques.description: 蓄力结束后瞬间恢复正常速度甚至加速，释放爆发力
techniques.prompt: sudden return to normal speed after slow-motion build-up, explosive release

techniques.name: 子弹时间
techniques.description: 撞击或交锋瞬间的极慢动作（能看清飞溅的血珠或碎裂的火花），随后瞬间快切
techniques.prompt: bullet time, extreme slow-motion capturing flying sparks and debris mid-air

speed_arc_template.description: 速度弧线模板：蓄力→骤静→Hit Stop→爆裂释放
speed_arc_template.structure: 起势清楚 → 爆发加速 → 命中清晰(Hit Stop) → 余势收尾
